title: Design: release-day Tiers list with one Default row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a staging client on which nobody has set up tiers since the release (its Tiers list shows only Default).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page opens on the Tiers tab, with the tabs Tiers, Matrices and Fixed Rules, each with its count.
  • Above the list it reads "1 active tier", with New Tier at the right.
  • The columns read #, Tier, Customers, Matrices and Status, in that order, as in picture 1.1.
  • The one row reads 1, Default, the customer count, All and a green Active badge, with a pencil and a three-dot button at the right.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
